description: More matching decisions of the real IAM policy engine, observed with iam:SimulateCustomPolicy through the AWS MCP Server on 2026-11-21, to settle whether `?` and `*` cross a colon inside an ARN (spec proofgate-brushup, fix of the oracle). Same format as aws-observations.json: Allow s3:GetObject on <pattern>, request for <value>; awsMatches is true for 'allowed'. Q01 is false only because `?` stands for one character and the value has two colons before `b`. Never edit.
